headline: Evolve Today vs Antal International: Boutique or National Executive Search in Romania?
description: Feature-by-feature comparison of Evolve Today and Antal International Romania, two executive and IT recruitment firms operating in Bucharest.

mainEntity.name: Executive Recruitment Agencies Compared: Evolve Today vs Antal International

item.name: Evolve Today
item.description: Bucharest-based IT, specialist, and executive recruitment firm with 16+ years of experience, also offering HR consulting and career counseling.

item.name: Antal International Romania
item.description: National executive recruitment agency founded in 2003, with 9 offices across Romania and a global network across 5 continents, specializing in C-level executive search and 8 named industry verticals.
